correctness.rationale: The listed 14 facets have all 21 edges, with each oriented edge used exactly once in each direction and each vertex link a 6-cycle. This is a connected orientable closed surface of Euler characteristic zero, and the unique seven-vertex torus identifies the fixed example. The singleton columns give rank seven. Independent hyperplane/coset generation of 29,211 message spaces and the sum of their word weights divided by 2^(r−1) reproduced every bin, including the ordinary distribution and minimizer counts (7,21,21,14,119,42,1). The repaired formula specialization was independently checked on every induced vertex subset: maximum facet counts at sizes 6 through 0 are 8,4,2,1,0,0,0.
residual_risks: The identity uses the known combinatorial uniqueness of the seven-vertex torus; publisher full text of Example 5.3 could not be independently read. The defined cyclic torus and every numerical result were checked directly.
